torch.description: A grim medieval WALL-MOUNTED BURNING TORCH for a first-person dark-fantasy dungeon game, straight-on view, entire narrow tall wrought-iron mounting plate and bent iron support bracket visible under an iron fuel basket. Realistic gritty hand-pixeled 1990s dark fantasy dungeon texture style, nuanced dithered metal shading, distressed material details and sharp native pixels. Aged muted iron and brown rust dominate. Flame is irregular, thin and turbulent, not a smooth cartoon flame or glowing icon. No bold black contour, no cute or clean vector shapes, no ornamental gold, no wall/background, no surrounding halo, no text. Isolated tall torch fixture on transparent alpha. All mounting hardware in frame.
